extDesc.message: Your passwords and notes, encrypted on your device. FastVault stores the locked box, never the key.

fastvaultAttribution.message: FastVault is based on the open-source Bitwarden® clients (GPL-3.0). Bitwarden is a trademark of Bitwarden, Inc., which is not affiliated with FastVault.

authenticatorAppDescV2.message: Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy to generate time-based verification codes.

secureDevicesBody.message: Log in on your other computers with the FastVault browser extension and desktop app, and on your phone with the official Bitwarden apps.

continueToAuthenticatorPageDesc.message: Use an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy to generate TOTP codes for 2-step verification.

continueToSecretsManagerPageDesc.message: FastVault does not offer a separate secrets-manager product.

freeBitwardenFamiliesPageDesc.message: FastVault has no free-plan eligibility program. See fastvault.app/pricing for plans.

getTheMobileAppDesc.message: Access your passwords on the go with the official Bitwarden apps.
